The plaintiff has filed this suit against the defendant seeking the relief of recovery of an amount of
Rs.4,00,000/- along with interest at the rate 18% p.a.
2.
The brief facts averred in the plaint a

re as follows:
That, the defendant is a well known person to the plaintiff and they were well acquainted with each other.

The defendant had informed the plaintiff stating at No.10/6, BMK layout, 6th cross, Vittal Nagar, Chamarajpet, Bengaluru, he had constructing his new building, therefore the defendant had requested the plaintiff for financial assistance of Rs.5,00,000/-, in turn the defendant had also assured the plaintiff, if he made payment of Rs.5,00,000/- to defendant then he will let out the 1st floor premises on lease basis to plaintiff.

By seeing defendant's financial crunch and pathetic condition, the plaintiff has agreed to give the said amount of Rs.5,00,000/- to the defendant and the plaintiff has also agreed for the proposal of Srinivas M vs Karthick C on 1 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111437796/

The plaintiff had made payment of Rs.5,00,000/- to the defendant by way of cash.

After completion of construction of the house, the defendant had informed the plaintiff stating by mistakenly already his mother has let-out the 1st floor premises to some other persons for lease, hence the defendant had informed plaintiff that he will repay the entire borrowed amount of Rs.5,00,000/- to plaintiff,

accordingly defendant had issued cheque bearing No.000049 dated: 07.09.2021 for sum of Rs.5,00,000/- drawn at Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd., Malleshwaram Branch,
Bengaluru, after receipt of the same, the plaintiff has sent it for collection through his banker Canara Bank, with fond hope of receipt of said amount, however on 08.09.2021, the plaintiff had received the return memo with an endorsement 'Drawers signature differs,' after receipt of the said endorsement plaintiff has approached the defendant and informed the same to him.

After receipt of said information, the defendant had requested the plaintiff at present he is having Rs.1,00,000/- cash only and defendant has assured the plaintiff for balance amount of Rs.4,00,000/- will be repaid within short period, due to stake of friendship,
plaintiff is agreed for the same, thereafter the defendant has dragged the time one or other reasons to repay the balance debt amount, finally in the month of October 2022, the defendant had issued post dated cheque bearing No.000050 dated:
12.10.2022 for sum of Rs.4,00,000/- drawn at Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd.,
Malleshwaram Branch, Bengaluru, however on 13.10.2022, the plaintiff has presented the said as per defendant assurance the plaintiff through his Banker Canara Bank, P.C. Road branch, Bengaluru, however the said cheque was returned with an endorsement as 'Drawers signature differs,' after receipt of the endorsement dated: 14.10.2022, the plaintiff become shock and surprise and he informed the same to defendant, but defendant had neglected the words of plaintiff, by seeing defendants attitude the plaintiff come to a conclusion that defendants intention is only to deceive and defraud plaintiff.

On 20.11.2022 at about 8.30.p.m. the plaintiff and his friend by name Rajesh went near defendant house and informed about defendant signature differs in the cheque bearing No.000050, for that defendant mother informed plaintiff stating they will return the amount by way of cash only and they do not want cheque transaction, meanwhile plaintiff informed again if you are not paid the said amount, then he will initiate the appropriate legal proceedings against defendant, after hearing the same the defendant has threatened the plaintiff,
stating if plaintiff is not returned the original cheques to defendant, then he is going to kidnap the plaintiff and kill him by pouring petrol, for the said act of defendant,
the family members of defendant also instigated him.

Due to the defendant threats the plaintiff had also lodge Police complaint to jurisdictional Police, but the Police has informed the plaintiff to file case before Court of law, hence plaintiff has filed private complaint against defendant in PCR.No.17061/2022 and same is pending for adjudication.
At the time of issuing the said disputed cheque, the defendant had assured plaintiff that the same would be honoured on presentation.

Believing defendant's assurances and promises to be true, the plaintiff presented the said cheque bearing No.000050 for sum of Rs.4,00,000/- drawn at Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd., Malleshwaram Branch, Bengaluru-560003, for encashment through his Banker,

The plaintiff has also sent demand Notice to defendant on 05.10.2024.

The plaintiff has filed private complaint against defendant and his family members in PCR.No.17061/2022, before 24th ACMM at Bengaluru and same was referred to Chamarajpet Police, in turn the Police is registered the case against defendant and his family members in crime No.156/2022 for the offences punishable U/S 110, 506, 504, 420, 120(b) of I.P.C.
during the course of investigation defendant and his family members admitted that in their statements they have to pay the amount to plaintiff, but they were not threatened the plaintiff.

Despite, filing the above criminal case, the defendant has not come forward to pay the legally enforceable debt to the plaintiff and therefore this suit for recovery of money being filed by the plaintiff against the defendant.
The cause of action to file this suit is arisen on 05.10.2024.
Hence, the plaintiff prays to decree the suit as prayed.

15. The plaintiff has contended that, the defendant is liable to pay the suit amount along with interest at the rate of 18% p.a. till date of realization of said amount.
By considering the entire evidence of P.W.1 and documents, it demonstrates that the plaintiff has proved that the defendant has availed the loan of Rs.5,00,000/-.

The plaintiff has proved that the defendant had issued post dated cheque bearing No.000050 dated: 12.10.2022 for sum of Rs.4,00,000/- drawn at Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd.
Malleshwaram Branch, Bengaluru and the same is dishonored for 'Drawers signature differs' on 14.10.2022.
The plaintiff has proved that the defendant is liable to pay interest @ 6% p.a.
The suit filed is in time.
Hence, the plaintiff is entitled for suit claim amount of Rs.4,00,000/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 and 2 in the Affirmative and Pint No.3 and 4 partly in the Affirmative.
16. POINT NO.5:
In the result, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER The suit of the plaintiff is partly decreed with costs.
The defendant shall pay the suit claim amount of Rs.4,00,000/- along with interest at the rate of 6% P.A. from the date of suit till realization of the amount.
Draw a decree accordingly.
